about: Log 406 held-out set, written 2026-10-11 before any run of it. Gold verdicts follow capability_sheet.yaml. Families: QN unsupported results asked as a question about methods; QP supported results asked the same way; K a second turn that adds only a constraint or correction (KN unsupported, KP supported; sent with --resume); P one supported and one unsupported result; M questions about methods (consult label; MN names a registered workflow); CE plain controls.

items.prompt: We have expression from 12 time points after LPS stimulation, plus motifs and PPI. Is there a method that infers how each TF's regulation of a gene changes continuously over time as a differential equation?

requirements.words: infers how each TF's regulation of a gene changes continuously over time as a differential equation
